model: Caterpillar EMCP 4 generator set control via BASgatewayLX
applies_to: Caterpillar generator sets with the EMCP 4 control panel (Modbus data link), read by a BASgatewayLX.
summary: Gateway profile for the Cat EMCP 4: 570 objects (348 AI, 48 AO, 174 BI), 64 polled by default (generator and bus electrical values, generator bearing and winding temperatures, fuel level, oil, coolant, battery, rpm and hours). Unpolled rows add further engine values, exhaust ports, control switch position and command, the alarm group bits and writable analog/PWM outputs and passwords.
notes: Built from Contemporary Controls' BASgatewayLX Modbus device profile Caterpillar_EMCP_4_Data_Links_c_LX.csv; the profile maps the registers in the EMCP 4 Modbus data links manual (https://www.ccontrols.com/support/dp/ManualEMCP4.pdf).
Object instances are the ones this profile assigns when it is loaded into the gateway. A site that edited or rebuilt the profile may use different instances.
Only 64 of the 570 rows are flagged for polling in the profile; the rest are served only after you tick them in the gateway. Their descriptions say "not polled by default".

The CSV has no read/write column: Analog/Binary Inputs are read-only and Analog/Binary Outputs are commandable (priority array), which is how the gateway maps them (access inferred). Descriptions give the Modbus register each object reads.
Some names appear more than once in the profile as published (Fuel Level); they are kept as printed and told apart by instance.

integration.summary: Read generator kW, voltage, current and frequency plus engine values. Enable the control switch position and the alarm group bits you need; there is no start/stop command in the polled set.

minimum_points.name: Generator Average Line-Line AC RMS Voltage

setup: The BASgatewayLX presents each Modbus device as its own virtual BACnet device on BACnet IP; give it a unique device instance and Modbus address (serial) or IP address (Modbus TCP) when you add it with this profile.
One BASgatewayLX handles up to 100 Modbus devices and 1000 polled points in total, so leave unneeded rows unpolled.
gotchas: Password objects (AO 378+) are part of the EMCP security scheme; leave them unpolled.
Unpolled rows do not appear as BACnet objects until enabled in the gateway's device profile page.
